definitions.explanation: A place where a war is being fought, or the area soldiers are sent to during a war.

examples.japanese: {戦地|せんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赴|おもむ}く→赴く：14261_omomuku⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{頃|ころ}、{戦地|せんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: When he was young, my grandfather was sent to the front.

examples.japanese: {戦地|せんち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The letters that arrived from the war zone are still carefully kept.

notes:
⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (war, battle) + {地|ち} (place).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦地|せんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赴|おもむ}く→赴く：14261_omomuku⟧ / ⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to go to the front
- {戦地|せんち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to come back from the war
- {戦地|せんち}⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧: war reporting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧: the battlefield itself, where fighting takes place; {戦地|せんち} is the wider war zone soldiers are posted to
- ⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧: the front line

WATCH OUT:
⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧ (centimeter) has the same reading.
